title: Pais told Ashton Forbes that the MH370 orbs show the Pais effect

tellings.quote: All I'm saying is when I saw that thing open up, I saw the pis effect on action and I told Ashen Ford that was his first podcast, hard truths podcast. I told him this is the Pis.

plain: A Navy scientist named Salvatore Pais, who holds patents on unusual craft designs, says that in 2023 he watched the videos said to show glowing orbs around the vanished airliner MH370 and saw in them the "Pais effect," a physics effect he named after himself, at work. He tells Michels he said so to Ashton Forbes on Forbes's first episode of his Hard Truths podcast: "when I saw that thing open up, I saw the Pais effect in action." If he is right, the videos would show his own theoretical physics being used in the real world.
